Night camp beside a small fire; consistent with the other RDR camp frames but quite generic by itself.

Photoreal/AI render of a drone on a college campus; no film or game world in it.

Same pencil-journal language as J010; reads as RDR2 journal, though the crossed grid is abstract.
Hand-drawn pencil scrapbook with taped note and Western scenery strongly echoes the RDR2 journal.
Footprints, folds, corner compass medallions and a ribbon title.

Candles hovering in a dark starfield; Hogwarts by association.
Ragged sails and lanterns plus the unmistakable gold compass.
Ladakh lake + yellow scooter evokes the film's final act. Alternative reading is Roman Holiday (Vespa), but the landscape does not match.
Red-ochre western sunset over a ranch in the grass strongly evokes Beecher's Hope-type RDR vistas.
Red steam engine on a curved stone arch viaduct in the Highlands is the exact film shot.
